description.value: Market Street Cafe is a café on Market Street in the Port Hardy area of northern Vancouver Island, a remote coastal region at the northern terminus of Highway 19. It operates Tuesday through Saturday mornings and middays, positioning it as a potential rest stop for cyclists completing or beginning the full Island ride. Very little additional public information is available to characterize the experience.
